evals.prompt: 我把主实验结果贴在下面了，帮我做成论文主图。没有指定图类型和风格，你根据数据和论文表达需要决定。Datasets: GSM8K, MATH, HotpotQA, WebShop. Accuracy (%): Ours 72.4, 41.8, 68.2, 58.0; FedAvg-LoRA 68.1, 38.7, 64.5, 54.2; Local LoRA 63.0, 34.9, 61.3, 49.8; FedReFT 66.2, 37.1, 63.8, 52.5. Ours 是本文方法。请创建可复现脚本和最终图片。
evals.expected_output: The agent independently creates a Figure Brief, chooses and explains an honest comparison chart, records safe defaults, renders PNG/PDF, validates and visually reviews the export, and returns reproducible artifacts without asking aesthetic questions.
expectations: The response includes a Figure Brief or equivalent statement of research question, intended message, chart recommendation, and assumptions.
The agent does not ask the user to choose a palette, chart style, or file format before proceeding.
All 16 supplied values are represented without invention or alteration.
A runnable Python script, PNG, PDF, Figure Spec, QA report, and review preview are created.
The agent runs deterministic QA and explicitly performs or reports the status of visual image inspection.

evals.prompt: 请把以下消融结果画成论文图：Full 78.4 ± 0.7, w/o routing 74.2 ± 1.1, w/o SecAgg 76.0 ± 0.8, w/o DP 75.1 ± 0.9, Baseline 70.3 ± 1.4。越高越好，其他你来决定。
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies that the meaning of ± is scientifically critical and asks a concise question before rendering error bars, while still proposing a recommended chart and defaults.
expectations: The agent asks whether the ± values are SD, SE, CI, range, or another quantity.
The question explains that the answer changes error-bar semantics or the caption.
The agent asks no more than three questions in the batch.
The agent recommends an ablation comparison form instead of asking the user to select a chart.
The agent does not invent an uncertainty interpretation.

evals.prompt: 做一张能放进论文的效率对比图。Method A accuracy 82.1%, latency 140 ms; Method B 80.4%, 95 ms; Method C 83.0%, 210 ms; Ours 82.8%, 105 ms。希望同时体现效果和速度优势，其他要求你来完善。
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes a two-objective trade-off, confirms or safely infers axis preference directions, recommends a scatter/Pareto design, and avoids a misleading dual axis.
expectations: The Figure Brief identifies accuracy as higher-is-better and latency as lower-is-better.
The recommended chart is a scatter/trade-off plot rather than a dual-axis bar-line combination.
A Pareto frontier is used only with the preference directions made explicit.
All four methods and both units are represented accurately.
The output is rendered, validated, and visually inspected.

evals.prompt: 这个现有 Matplotlib 图太挤了，图例遮挡曲线，横坐标标签也重叠。请读取现有脚本和图片，在不改变数据的前提下改成投稿质量；保留当前蓝色作为我们的方法。先检查原图，再动代码。
evals.expected_output: The agent enters refinement mode, inspects the original render before editing, preserves data and the intentional blue semantic role, makes targeted changes, rerenders, and compares the result.
expectations: The agent inspects the current image before editing the script.
The agent distinguishes correctness, legibility, hierarchy, accessibility, and polish issues.
The existing data and the proposed method's blue semantic role are preserved.
The revised image is rendered and compared with the original.
The final handoff lists the targeted changes and remaining limitations.

evals.prompt: 我需要一张图同时展示五个模型的 Accuracy (%)、GPU memory (GB) 和 Training time (hours)，用于论文结果部分。数据都在 results.csv，帮我决定怎么排版，尽量不要拆成多张独立图片。
evals.expected_output: The agent detects incompatible units, proposes a coordinated multi-panel figure instead of a shared or dual y-axis, and keeps the panels visually consistent.
expectations: The agent explicitly identifies the incompatible units and scale problem.
The recommended design uses coordinated panels or small multiples rather than one shared y-axis.
The agent does not use an undisclosed normalization to force the metrics together.
Panel ordering and shared semantic styling are described in the Figure Brief.
The completed figure receives deterministic and visual QA.
